title: APIs & Keys
motto: Every AI API works the same way: send a request, get a response. The details change, the pattern doesn't.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Every AI API works the same way: send a request, get a response. The details change, the pattern doesn't.

steps.title: Keys before agents
cards: From Phase 11 you'll call LLM APIs in loops. Agents in Phases 13–16 depend on authenticated HTTP requests with rate limits and token billing.
Never commit API keys. Use environment variables or .env files (gitignored). Understand raw HTTP before relying on SDK magic.

steps.title: Request anatomy
steps.body: Every call has an endpoint URL, an API key header, a JSON request body, and a JSON response. SDKs wrap this — debugging starts at the HTTP layer.

steps.title: Implement mask_secret
steps.body: Log and UI must never print full API keys. mask_secret(secret, visible=4) keeps first/last N chars, masks the middle with asterisks.

artifact.name: API key hygiene
artifact.description: You can store keys in env vars, mask them in logs, and read auth errors without leaking credentials.
